description: Head-movement mini-game G14: level-hold game, voice-guided. Tap start, 1-second settle capturing the level reference, then hold the head level for 10 continuous seconds. Level is relative roll from the AbsoluteOrientationSensor quaternion, within plus/minus 8 degrees of the settle reference; pitch/yaw drift alone does not break level. A tilt beyond the band sustained over 0.3 seconds resets the timer to 0 and auto-restarts; after 5 resets in one round the game suggests a rest and returns to ready. No turning at all, no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: level-keep
